# Irha Apparels

> OEM, ODM and private-label apparel manufacturer based in Sialkot, Pakistan — Bavarian wear, sportswear, leatherwear, streetwear, leisurewear and nightwear exported worldwide.

Irha Apparels is a B2B apparel manufacturer producing premium garments for brands, retailers and sourcing teams across the USA, EU, UAE and beyond. We offer in-house cutting, stitching, embroidery, sublimation, leather work and a full sampling studio. Minimum order quantities start at 30–100 pieces depending on category.

- [Home](/): Overview of Irha Apparels — categories, capabilities and how to start an order.
- [About](/about): Company story, Sialkot atelier, leadership and values.
- [Collections](/products): All six apparel categories with 600+ styles, sub-categories and downloadable catalogs.
- [Manufacturing](/manufacturing): Production capacity, machinery, QC standards and lead times.
- [Sustainability](/sustainability): Certifications (OEKO-TEX, GOTS, BCI, RWS, LWG), recycled materials and ethical practices.
- [Journal](/journal): Editorial articles on craft, sourcing and the apparel industry.
- [FAQ](/faq): MOQs, sampling, customization, shipping, payment terms and QC.
- [Inquiry](/inquiry): B2B inquiry form for quotes, samples and program briefs.
- [Contact](/contact): Email, WhatsApp and Sialkot atelier address.
